returns._2: Timestamp at which the current epoch can be rebased.
returns._3: NET queued for distribution at next rebase.

returns._0: The sNET amount credited (1:1 net of any warmup).

claim(address).notice: Claims sNET matured past warmup (no-op path when warmup is 0).

enable().notice: Enables staking and starts the epoch clock. GenesisBond only, once.

enabled().notice: True once staking has been enabled by GenesisBond.finalize().

rebase().notice: Advances the epoch if elapsed: distributor mint → sNET rebase.         Permissionless; also checkpoints the TWAP oracle (OPEN_QUESTIONS D1).

stake(address,uint256).notice: Stakes `amount` NET from the caller, minting sNET to `to`.

totalStaked().notice: Total NET held for stakers (backs all sNET fragments 1:1).

unstake(address,uint256).notice: Burns `amount` sNET from the caller, returning NET to `to`.

warmupEpochs().notice: Warmup in epochs (DEFAULT 0 — TUNE BEFORE DEPLOY). Constructor         arg (from Constants in deploy scripts) for testability.

wire(address,address,address).notice: One-time wiring (Distributor ↔ Staking are mutually         referential). Frozen afterwards; on the emissions path this is         the only address set, and it cannot be re-set (invariant §6.7).
